evals.prompt: Generate a DESIGN.md for Stripe based on their website at stripe.com. I want the full 9-section Stitch format with preview HTML files.
evals.expected_output: A comprehensive DESIGN.md following the 9-section Stitch format with Stripe's color palette, typography, component styles, plus preview.html and preview-dark.html files.
expectations: DESIGN.md contains all 9 numbered sections (1-9) with correct headers
Section 2 defines at least 15 unique hex color codes with semantic names in bold
Section 3 contains a markdown table with at least 12 rows covering typography hierarchy
Section 4 defines at least 3 distinct button variants with specific padding, radius, and color values
Section 6 contains an elevation table with at least 4 levels and CSS box-shadow strings
Section 7 contains at least 6 Do items and 6 Don't items
preview.html file exists and is valid self-contained HTML
preview-dark.html file exists and is valid self-contained HTML
Colors referenced in Section 4 components use semantic names that appear in Section 2
Section 8 contains a breakpoints table with at least 3 entries

evals.prompt: Create a DESIGN.md for a brutalist dark-mode developer tool called 'Forge'. Think monospace everything, high contrast, neon accents on near-black backgrounds, no rounded corners, minimal decoration. It should feel like a terminal had a baby with a design system.
evals.expected_output: A DESIGN.md with a brutalist aesthetic: monospace fonts, sharp corners (0px radius), high-contrast neon-on-dark palette, minimal shadows, dense spacing. Plus preview HTML files.
expectations: DESIGN.md contains all 9 numbered sections (1-9) with correct headers
Section 2 defines at least 15 unique hex color codes with semantic names in bold
Section 3 contains a markdown table with at least 12 rows covering typography hierarchy
Section 4 defines at least 3 distinct button variants with specific padding, radius, and color values
Section 6 contains an elevation table with at least 4 levels
Section 7 contains at least 6 Do items and 6 Don't items
preview.html file exists and is valid self-contained HTML
preview-dark.html file exists and is valid self-contained HTML
Border radius values are 0px throughout (brutalist requirement)
Section 3 specifies monospace font family for all text roles
